property_summary: Reference contract C requires callers to send exactly 1 ether when calling lockInGuess, so for any caller who has not already locked in a guess a call to lockInGuess with value != 1 ether will revert (preventing the guess from being recorded); the mutant removing the msg.value==1 ether check allows calls with other values to succeed and therefore will record guesses for some inputs (amounts) that the reference rejects.
change_summary: Remove the requirement that msg.value equals 1 ether (delete the value check), allowing any value to be accepted.
